page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes or footnotes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: mentum,aut calidum & ficcu, aut calidum humidum: aut frigidum ficcu, vel frigidum & humidum. Igitur primæ qualitates ele-mentorum,neq; primo, neq; per se permi-scentur. Nam (ut iam prædiximus) constantibus elementorum formis, non temperantur,aut permiscentur. Deniq; nisi totis totę[?] permiscerentur elementorum substantiæ,in cuiusuis misti procreatione,nullum certè mistum una tantum materia,& una forma constaret,sed pluribus. Totidem enim ma-terias & essentiales formas obtineret,quot in eo remanerent integrę, & impermistæ elementorum substantiæ. Proinde alteru-trum cotingeret absurdum: aut plura simul corpora,& eodem tempore unū eundemq; locum occupare: aut corporum fieri pene-trationem,a qua(ut & a vererum uacuo) naturam tantopere abhorrere clariores phi-lofophi tradiderunt. At enim absq; ulla pe-netratione permiscentur elementa: quan-doquidem mistione, in unam & propriam misti materiam confluunt ac definunt. Sed quid pluribus opus est? Cum ipsemet Fer-nelius elementorum substantias permisce-ri in mistorum procreatione libro de Ab-ditis rerum causis sæpenumero reperat.

page.notes: The catchword "Vt" is printed in capitals and converted to "Ut" by the u/v rule. "vererum" in the phrase "a vererum uacuo" is doubtful: the scan reads "uererum", and the word is not certain. The "totq" at the end of a line is doubtful and is marked [?]. Long s has been set as plain s throughout. Line-end hyphens are kept inside the joined words, for example "ele-mentorum" and "permi-scentur".
